name: Tainan
tagline: Taiwan's oldest city and its food capital
summary: Tainan is Taiwan's old capital, packed with temples, forts and some of the island's best street food. See Chihkan Tower and Anping Fort, wander the banyan-wrapped Anping Tree House and the lanes of Shennong Street, and eat danzai noodles, beef soup and milkfish.
seasonNote: Autumn to spring is warm and dry; summer is hot with typhoon risk.
arrival: Tainan HSR station is 30 minutes from the centre; Kaohsiung airport is about an hour.
gettingAround: Scooter, bike share or taxi; buses to Anping.
cashTip: Night markets and small shops are cash-only; an EasyCard covers transit and convenience stores.
foodTip: Danzai noodles, beef soup, milkfish and coffin bread.
